name: WA Gold Limited
summary: WA Gold Limited, a mineral exploration company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral resource projects in Australia. The company primarily explores for gold and lithium deposits. Its flagship project is the Abercromby gold project located in the Agnew-Wiluna Greenstone Belt, Western Australia. The company was formerly known as BMG Resources Limited and changed its name to WA Gold Limited in April 2026. The company is based in West Perth, Australia.
